protocol.model: Same frozen committed planner and archived primary incumbent per root; V8 local-event replay is a separate execution sensitivity.
protocol.adapter: Only the primary path is executed. All arms board on visible target departure and explicitly alight for a transfer. WAIT retains platform physical inertia. A planned wait delays target boarding to at least root+60, when platform inertia permits.
protocol.release: One charged background update at root+ceil(measured worker wall). Check current stop, onboard trip, incoming leg and arrival phase, unchanged boarded prefix and no public departure/cancellation of the next target.
protocol.unresolved: V8 issued-target and next same-service audit; unresolved loss kept as elapsed/deadline interval. No V8-platform guarantee is inferred from the committed certificate.
